title: H1 antihistamines: naming and classes (R-10005)
description: H1 antihistamines are drugs whose mechanism of action is: block histamine H1 receptors, easing allergy symptoms. This class has no single naming suffix. Example drugs include cetirizine, loratadine, diphenhydramine.
